content: {"phoneNote":"Phone reads well: photo first, headline fits, one button; the footer's huge 'Gostilna Pri Zlati Žlici' heading wraps awkwardly and the price grid leaves ragged gaps.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero card overlapping the photo works, but the prices section and opening hours leave the right half of the 1280px canvas empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop: fill the right half of 'Kdaj smo odprti' with a map or address block, and tighten the price grid so 'Orehovi štruklji' doesn't sit alone on a second row with large empty bands.","Phone: shrink the footer business-name heading to the body-brand size; its two-line display setting dwarfs the hero headline.","Both: give the text columns beside the dish/terrace/kitchen photos a vertical centre and cap the photo heights so the 'Z domače mize' block isn't a wide shallow text next to a tall image."],"blockers":[]}
